sources.title: Django support
sources.observation: 5.2.18 is current 5.2 LTS patch; extended support through April 2028. Django 4.2 EOL April 7 2026.

sources.title: Django Python matrix
sources.observation: 5.2 supports Python 3.10–3.14; latest maintained micro releases required; third-party libraries have their own compatibility.

sources.title: Python lifecycle
sources.observation: 3.12 security maintenance through October 2028; host 3.14 need not be shared with the website.

sources.title: Django MariaDB support
sources.observation: MariaDB 10.5+ through shared MySQL backend; use maintained vendor series, strict mode and utf8mb4.

sources.title: Node releases
sources.observation: Node 22 is supported LTS; do not reuse obsolete Node18/20 installation examples.

sources.title: Redis OSS lifecycle
sources.observation: Redis 7.4 Extended release is listed GA, EOL December 1 2029; not Redis Software enterprise lifecycle.

sources.title: Celery 5.6
sources.observation: Python 3.12 appears in 5.6 supported versions; upstream site pins celery<6 due legacy settings removal.

sources.title: Official installation source
sources.observation: Operational topology and build steps inspected; dependency versions superseded by tested A09 locks.

sources.title: Official website upgrade
sources.observation: Official django-52-upgrade feature branch; exact Git retrieval verified, unmerged into observed master.

sources.title: Fork considered
sources.observation: Still Django>=4.2,<5 when inspected; no reason to select this fork over official 5.2 work.
